rationale: B wins because it turns the scariest fact into a real beat story: "Who is responsible for a flight when no one is flying it?" That is sharper than A burying the same regulatory issue as proof under "Skydio's pilotless inspection drone wants to take the lineworker off the truck." A is good, but it spends a slot on "Two years after quitting consumer drones, Skydio bets the pivot on power lines," which smells like a company-profile consolation prize without revenue, customer names, or scale.
gaps_in_A: "take the lineworker off the truck" overreaches. The update says no pilot, not that lineworkers leave trucks or workflows change materially.
"Two years after quitting consumer drones, Skydio bets the pivot on power lines" is the weakest angle. It needs business proof the update does not provide, so it is mostly Skydio narrative.

"the counterposition (US-vs-China) angle is the strongest one here" is bad prioritization. Without a live import-restriction peg or utility procurement proof, it is not stronger than the inspection-workflow story.

"Several US utilities trust Skydio's new inspection drone" is correctly refused, but calling "several" unverified is sloppy. The release attributes that claim to Skydio; the real issue is unnamed and unquantified, not nonexistent.
gaps_in_B: "at least one specific defect the automated reports flagged" is a smart proof demand, but it makes the first angle unpitchable from the supplied update alone. B admits this, but the lead angle still depends on missing customer evidence.

"closer to plant equipment than to an aircraft" is a strong frame, but "bought and budgeted like a sensor installation" is inferred, not grounded. It needs procurement proof before anyone should pitch it that way.
"regulators have been slow to accommodate" may be true, but it is not in the update. Fine as context to verify, not as a settled claim.

"The strongest angle is dead without one" is too absolute. The named-customer operations story is dead without one; the regulatory and policy angles can still live if Skydio can answer the authorization and sourcing questions.
